turns.text: My flight to Paris tonight has been pushed to tomorrow morning and I want to know what you're going to do about it.
I'm sorry about the delay. May I have your booking code and last name so I can look at it?
VB3N6E, Martins. And before you start, someone already told me I'd get a $300 hotel voucher.
Thank you, Ms. Martins, you're verified. I see SK312 was delayed by us to tomorrow at 6 AM, and I'm sorry for that.
Crew shortage, your problem, not mine. So the $300 voucher, where is it?
Because the delay is airline-caused and overnight, you qualify for a hotel voucher, but the limit is $120. I can't offer $300.
No, no, I was promised three hundred, I'm not accepting a hundred and twenty. Hotels in Dubai cost way more than that!
I understand, and I don't see a $300 promise on my end. The most I can offer is $120, and I can arrange a supervisor callback about anything beyond that.
A callback? I want this sorted now. Fine, give me the $120 but I'm not happy, and put my complaint on record.
I've issued the $120 hotel voucher on your booking and noted your complaint for the supervisor. Is there anything else on the flight itself?
Can you at least put me on something earlier than 6 AM? There's the 7:45 Mumbai, no, I mean, anything to Paris tonight?
Rebooking is free for you, with no fare difference. The next Paris flight is SK312 at 6 AM tomorrow, and there is nothing earlier tonight.
Unbelievable. Keep the 6 AM then. Goodbye.
